name: EH3D-PHOENIX-PNP
notes: EH3D-PHOENIX-PNP is the pick and place program of the PHOENIX family (green phoenix), formerly EH3D-PNP-MANAGER. Scaffolding v0.0.4: a library and a command line for pick and place assembly: they read the position file of a board (KiCad .pos or a CSV from another CAD program, in mm, mil or inches), give every part the feeder that holds its value and package, report the parts without a feeder and the feeders that will run out, and plan the order of the placements for a head with one to six nozzles, with the bottom side mirrored, as a JSON job. Unreleased work adds a machine configuration file, tables of parts and packages, feeders with priority, trays and strips, a planner with ranks, nozzle tips and the time of the moves, panels, a load sheet, a simulated machine and a job that can be paused and resumed. A window (feature gui) with tabs, a map of the work table, problems with fixes and a simulated job, whose logic is tested without a screen; no camera and no machine control; nothing has placed a part.
